steps.content: You ram open the door with all your might, and the world suddenly falls silent. The music trails off, and everyone stares at you blankly...
Then, a glass slips from the waiter's hand and shatters on the floor.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Holy sh...!

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Cough cough... Don't worry, sir, the show won't start for another ten minutes. You're just in time. Please, take a seat, wherever you want.
steps.female_content: Cough cough... Don't worry, ma'am, the show won't start for another ten minutes. You're just in time. Please, take a seat, wherever you want.

steps.content: The patrons staring at you slowly turn away their gaze and continue on with their revelry.

There are no four-leaf clovers or crazed Sinners around here. No matter how you look at it, the place seems like an ordinary bar. On the contrary, you're the one who seems odd from the brash way you entered.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Is this your first time here? What a coincidence! We're serving limited specials tonight. Anyone who's tasted it loves it. You see, everyone here is a repeat customer.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: The entry fee is only 100 DisCoins... It's a real bargain...
You rummage through your pockets and discover that Hella has taken away all your cards and cash.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to find someone. I'll leave in a minute.

steps.content: You look around, scrutinizing every intoxicated person, trying to find the one spitting out black clovers. That person is both a Sleepwalker and the "Sinner" you're looking for.
You finally find her—a blue-haired girl sleeping in a corner by the window. Her face is red, and she is mumbling to herself.

steps.speaker: Blue-Haired Maiden
steps.content: Hehe... Daddy...

You catch her head before it slips and hits the windowsill. At the same time, a small black four-leaf clover flutters out from the corner of her mouth. You grab the clover, triggering a response from your shackles.
She's definitely a Sinner. She is passively releasing her Sinner power via the black goo clovers spewing from her mouth.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Roulecca</color>, No. <color=#fb9259>S-666</color>, a Sinner roaming through West District. She has a violent temperament and is extremely unstable emotionally.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The contaminants that attacked you just now came from her. They are laced with S-666's power, <color=#fb9259>Unbeatable Luck</color>, which triggered the alarm for District 14.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, to stop the spread of the contaminants, you must first get her out of her sleepwalking condition.
You pat Roulecca lightly on the face and call out her name, but you get no response no matter how much you shake her.
You release your shackles while no one is looking, but you fail to wake up Roulecca. In fact, you don't even feel like you've successfully linked to her.
At that moment, a sweet and alluring fragrance drifts into your nostrils. You notice a glowing glass of familiar liquid on the table before Roulecca... That woman had offered you some, too!

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: This glass is on me. A glass of Ambrosia, as a token of my thanks.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: A toast to you, my dear guest. May you have sweet dreams tonight.
The girl's mirage appears faintly in the dreamy liquid. Stunned, you get a bad feeling about this.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Ambrosia? Is her consciousness trapped in here?

steps.content: How can you call it "trapped"? Roulecca stays there because Ambrosia makes her happy...

A hand slowly pushes open the window, and a little head with purple hair pops out. The girl presses her chin against the window frame and smiles at you with her head tilted. A gaudy patched bear doll dangles from her shoulders.

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Like everyone else, she came here to seek joy. Joy comes from <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>, and everyone's favorite Ambrosia...

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: ...Comes from me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You were spreading Ambrosia? You created the Sleepwalkers?

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: I'm the supplier... The biggest supplier... You want to try some too, mister?
steps.female_content: I'm the supplier. The biggest supplier... You want to try some too, miss?

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: But you came too late. This is the last glass of the night, and I already gave it to Roulecca.

With a grin, she climbs in through the window and overturns the table with her feet, sending the glass of Ambrosia flying into the air. Roulecca's mirage shudders and begins to disintegrate. It's her consciousness!

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Too slow!

She reaches out, snatches the flying glass, and catches all the liquid. She then turns around, kicks you to the ground, and pins you between the legs of a round stool. Finally, she puts one leg on the stool seat.
You are now on your back, firmly pinned by the stool under her foot.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief... Answer me, Chief! What's going on?!

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Risking your life for a glass of Ambrosia? How thirsty are you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Roulecca's consciousness is in here, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to kill her?

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Oh? So you're risking your life for someone else? What a good Samaritan! A boring ol' goody two-shoes...

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Don't worry, Roulecca is my friend. Although we've only known each other for a little while, I won't hurt her. I just want her to be happy.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sob... Daddy... Everyone... Come play again...
Roulecca spits out some more black four-leaf clovers. Several of them stick to your face, making you feel nauseous. The purple-haired girl grabs some of the ones floating in the air.

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Sniff... Hmph, you usually have so many funny ideas. How come the things you spit out are so bitter?

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Not pure enough, not good enough, I have to keep looking...
No one is trying to stop the commotion. Some guests around you even whistle and applaud. The only waiter backs away farther and farther, trembling as he looks in your direction.
You try to push the stool away, but the purple-haired girl is shockingly strong. Is she a Sinner? Your shackles show no response. Does this mean she hasn't even started using her powers yet?
The purple-haired girl notices your gaze. She turns, leans down, and looks at you through the stool.

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: You wanna try some Ambrosia, too? A little weakling, a good Samaritan, a big fool... Want a sweet dream of your own?

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Hahaha, all right, then! Take some!

Bellowing with laughter, she straightens herself and pours the Ambrosia in her hand on your face. You quickly shut your mouth and hold your breath, but the sweetness seems to seep into all your orifices.

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: Don't close your mouth, you'll choke! Don't try to dodge, either. Roulecca's consciousness is in it. If you want to save her, you shouldn't let it spill everywhere...

The sweet, nauseating liquid ultimately flows into your body through your nose and lips. You realize this isn't the first time you've experienced this feeling. Still, your consciousness begins to blur, float, levitate, and depart.

steps.speaker: Purple-haired Girl
steps.content: I really look forward to seeing what kind of malice you'll spit out!
You hear an angry shout, the exclamations of the crowd, and the laughter of the purple-haired girl... Then you completely lose consciousness.
It's you... A blank, dreamless canvas... What a strange soul... I can't touch your heart, yet you managed to break in here...
Oh... I get it. Your dreams are not your own... You disturbed someone else's paradise...
Hehe... What will you give me?
